data: Amazon delivered a strong fiscal 2024. Revenue rose 11.0% to $638.0 billion from $574.8 billion in fiscal 2023, while net income grew 94.7% to $59.2 billion from $30.4 billion, so profit expanded far faster than sales. Cash generation improved as well, with operating cash flow reaching $115.9 billion in fiscal 2024 against $84.9 billion in fiscal 2023. The balance sheet also strengthened. Total assets climbed to $624.9 billion at the end of fiscal 2024 from $527.9 billion in fiscal 2023, while total liabilities increased more modestly to $338.9 billion from $326.0 billion. Cash and cash equivalents stood at $78.8 billion in fiscal 2024, up from $73.4 billion in fiscal 2023. Taken together, the fiscal 2024 figures point to improving profitability, strong internal funding capacity and a firmer financial position.
